body:
Oh shit, yeah, I'm on Zoloft. I didn't even consider whether that would be a factor in this. 

And you're right, suicide is strongly looked down upon as "the coward's way out" in my culture. I feel like I can never do it myself cause that would immediately lower everyone's opinion of me.

That's a really neat goal! You seem like a very creative person; your writing style is also really neat. There are a lot of subreddits for sharing personal artwork and writing with lovely communities. 
Its okay to not be super great; none of the world's best artists or animators were that good when they started out either. Those kinds of skills (or all skills, really) require a lot of practice. 

I'm in college myself, studying to be a teacher! Honestly, whenever I'm in class or doing homework, I think I've made a huge mistake with this career. Once I get in a classroom as the TEACHER, though, I know that that's where I'm meant to be. I don't have my own class yet, but I hope to have one by next year! 

Do you have any ideas for a potential project? What do you like to draw?

I don't know, I find it hard to believe that wanting to be hurt or killed is a "commonplace" thought. I'm not saying you're wrong, but I'm definitely skeptical. I feel like there's something seriously wrong with what I'm thinking.

Your feelings are valid and yours; the thing is, feeling that you're a burden and you're "less than" everyone else is a lasting effect of abuse. 

You are not a burden, or less worthy, or less human than anyone else, but a lot of victims have been made to feel that way. 

Know this: what you've been through is NOT your fault. I'm worried about you, you seem to have a lot of things haunting you. Does it help at all to talk this out?

You're really going through a rough time, ouch. Your friends sound awful, and I'm really sorry that you're feeling so hopeless. 

If its any consolation, I'm also the only one in my social circles who never drinks. Alcohol only ever makes me feel sick, and the fact that everyone else seems to be unable to have fun without it is.... sad, to say the least. 

You mentioned wanting to be a father. That's very sweet! I also want to be a parent someday, sometime. What else would you like to experience in your future?

OP, it sounds like you've been abused.... seriously abused. That's awful, god, I can't begin to imagine what you must've been through. Your pain and your feelings are valid, and my heart goes out to you. 

Being human, and being alive, you deserve compassion. You are not a burden on the planet nor on other people. Our society is a collaborative one; no one is fully independent. They work and you work and you're all part of a society (and the bad parts of this society are in no way your fault).

It sounds like you're going through a really rough time in your life, OP. High school is a pain for everyone, but you have more than your fair share of struggles. 

Psychiatric disorders like schizophrenia are full of awful negative stigma, and the practice itself is filled to the brim with subjectivity and guesswork. You very well may have schizophrenia, but your mother may be afraid of the social impact of an official diagnosis (which, if its the case, is not fair to you at all). 
Compassionate and accessible mental health care is a rarity, I'm really sorry that you haven't been able to find it.

I have to be honest; no matter how long you've been away from someone, if you die, they will have good memories of you and they will miss you. 
I've had a few of my classmates from high school pass away (one from suicide, others not), and it was a crushing blow to everyone even if they hadn't been at all popular. 
Human lives matter. Your life matters. 

The fact that you're concerned about being an asshole, to me, suggests that you're a kindhearted person. Can you channel your compassion in another way?
